title: Fair catalogue-distance band dot field (visible-trace only) vs uniform null, with a leakage-suspect legacy reference

evaluator.folds: NW, NE, SW, SE x seeds (20, 21) x modes (all, detached) = 16 cells
evaluator.score: pooled DTI over cells (sum tp, fp, fn); per-cell DTI reported alongside
evaluator.label: HOLDOUT-DTI (evaluator version, withheld positives, 95% CI)

hypothesis: A dot field placed in a distance band from VISIBLE catalogue traces (the band is computed from visible traces only, never from withheld traces) recovers withheld fault pixels better than an equal-count uniform random field on the same fold.
mechanism: Withheld segments are fault traces that lie near, and often parallel to, mapped traces that remain visible. Distance to the visible catalogue is therefore the only feature in this lane.
named_non_fault_mimic: Mapping density and survey coverage: traces are mapped where field and LiDAR coverage is dense, so distance-to-trace may proxy for where surveyors looked rather than where faults are. This would inflate holdout scores and does not transfer to a leaderboard whose truth was labelled by the same experts.

arms.N0_uniform_null: Uniform random footprint pixels, count matched per cell to the B1 arm (seed 20). Null for the whole lane.
arms.B1: Band (1.0, 2.0] px from visible traces, thinned to min spacing 2.8284 px, nearest-first, budget = 0.6174 x visible footprint catalogue pixels in the cell (= 37,654 / 60,988, the full-grid dot-to-catalogue ratio of the reference 37,654-dot files).
arms.B2: Band (2.0, 3.0] px, same thinning and budget rule.
arms.B3: Band (3.0, 5.0] px, same thinning and budget rule.
arms.O_oracle_sanity: Truth pixels themselves (harness sanity; DTI should be near 1.0). Not a candidate.
arms.L_legacy_leaky: GEMSDOE32 h33-h33-2-b2 (0.2778 owner-reported) evaluated as-is on the same cells. It was built from the FULL catalogue, so it is LEAKAGE-SUSPECT and is reported only to quantify leakage.

canary.feature: distance to visible traces, scored on active (scored, non-visible) pixels
canary.metric: AUC of -distance for truth vs non-truth on each cell; pooled across cells
canary.rule: AUC above 0.90 = leakage until proven otherwise (protocol rule 4)

experiment_budget.experiment_2: B2, B3 (band sweep, same instrument). Band selection rule below.

selection_rule: The candidate band is the argmax of pooled HOLDOUT-DTI among B1, B2, B3 ONLY if its paired difference vs N0 has a 95% CI excluding 0. If none passes, the lane is NEGATIVE and no unique candidate is promoted from it.
uniqueness_rule: Final dot field overlap (fraction of its dots within 3 px of a dot in each registry raster) must be at most 0.70 against every local reference raster (9 fleet files, published TIFFs in docs/downloads), and rank-correlation of the surface at most 0.90 (uniqueness.surface_rho).
format_rule: Single-band float32 GeoTIFF, EPSG:32611, shape 3730x3292, transform (100,0,243350,0,-100,4508550), values finite and in [0,1] everywhere, zeros outside the footprint (-zeros form). NaN is not used in the candidate.
submission_rule: Output is NOT cleared for upload by this lane. Upload approval requires the repo's literal full-support witness gate, which the README records as unsatisfied, plus an organizer receipt. This lane does not change any gate.
not_claimed: No live leaderboard score is claimed for any file.
No holdout result is a leaderboard projection.
No legacy owner-reported score is verified.
